_note: Quests (docs/design/quests_levels_story.md section 5). Every number is a [PLACEHOLDER]. Read by scripts/quests/quest_engine.gd, which only watches what GameState already keeps. A quest: kind (story, lab, personal, daily), giver (a cast id), title, scope (farm; player waits for build step 8), gates (lab_level, band, skill {id, level}, total_level, quest_points, quest_done: all must hold), offer (when: always, day_at_least with day, or any step check with its fields), steps (in order unless any_order is true) and rewards (credits, lab_xp, xp_<skill id>, quest_points, phone: a path in dialogue_dispatches.json or the line itself). A step: id, text, check and its fields, at_least (1 if left out). The count and counter checks count from the day the quest was accepted unless ever is true. Checks: stat_at_least (stat), flag (flag), band_at_least (band), owns_standard (standard_id), lab_size, count (log, where), state_is (state, is: one value or a list), level (skill: a skill id, lab or total), counter (counter: a source id of data/skills.json). Lab and daily quests pay no quest points. The lab-level gates of the design's unlock table are not here: they wait for build step 9.
